definitions.gloss: one side; single side; one face
definitions.explanation: One side or face of a flat object, as opposed to both sides. Used for paper, discs, tape, and other flat items.

examples.japanese: {片面|かためん}だけ{印刷|いんさつ}する。
examples.english: To print on one side only.

examples.japanese: {片面|かためん}テープで{壁|かべ}にポスターを{貼|は}った。
examples.english: I stuck a poster on the wall with single-sided tape.

examples.japanese: この{用紙|ようし}は{片面|かためん}にしか{書|か}けないので、{両面|りょうめん}に{書|か}けるものに{変|か}えてください。
examples.english: You can only write on one side of this paper, so please switch to one that allows writing on both sides.

notes:
USAGE:
Often used as a modifier: {片面|かためん}{印刷|いんさつ} (single-sided printing), {片面|かためん}テープ (single-sided tape). The opposite is {両面|りょうめん} (both sides, double-sided).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {片面|かためん}{印刷|いんさつ} (single-sided printing)
- {片面|かためん}テープ (single-sided tape)
- {片面|かためん}コピー (single-sided copy)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {両面|りょうめん}: both sides, double-sided — the opposite
- {表面|ひょうめん}: surface, front side — specifically the front/top side
- {裏面|りめん}: back side, reverse — the back/underside
